meta.description: Curated starter catalog of common GIMP PDB procedures for PixelPilot RAG and API hallucination validation.
meta.version_compat_notes: 'signature' uses the classic gimpfu/pdb call style (works in GIMP 2.10 Python-Fu and GIMP 3.x's gimpfu shim). 'gimp3_signature' notes the GObject-Introspection style used by GIMP 3 native Python plugins where known.

procedures.name: gimp-image-list
procedures.description: List all open images. First result is the primary canvas.
pitfalls: Index [0] is the most recently created image, not necessarily the active one.

procedures.name: gimp-image-width
procedures.description: Return the width of an image in pixels.
pitfalls: There is NO gimp_image_get_width in Python-Fu - use pdb.gimp_image_width(image).

procedures.name: gimp-image-height
procedures.description: Return the height of an image in pixels.
pitfalls: There is NO gimp_image_get_height in Python-Fu - use pdb.gimp_image_height(image).

procedures.name: gimp-image-undo-group-start
procedures.description: Start an undo group so many operations undo as one step.
pitfalls: Always pair with gimp_image_undo_group_end, ideally in try/finally.

procedures.name: gimp-image-undo-group-end
procedures.description: End an undo group.

procedures.name: gimp-image-flatten
procedures.description: Flatten all layers into a single background layer.
pitfalls: Destructive - merges everything. Consider duplicating first.

procedures.name: gimp-image-duplicate
procedures.description: Duplicate the whole image.

procedures.name: gimp-image-scale-full
procedures.description: Scale the whole image to new dimensions.
pitfalls: INTERPOLATION_* constants come from gimpfu.

procedures.name: gimp-image-convert-rgb
procedures.description: Convert the image to RGB color mode (needed before many filters).
pitfalls: Many plug-ins silently fail or behave oddly in non-RGB modes.

procedures.name: gimp-layer-new
procedures.description: Create a new layer of given size, type, opacity and blend mode.
procedures.signature: pdb.gimp_layer_new(image, width, height, type, name, opacity, mode)
pitfalls: The new layer is NOT inserted automatically - call gimp_image_insert_layer.

CRITICAL for scene composition: RGB_IMAGE layers have NO alpha channel and initialize opaque black - they hide every layer below them. Use RGBA_IMAGE for layers that are only partially painted (sun, clouds, mountains) so unpainted areas stay transparent.

procedures.name: gimp-image-insert-layer
procedures.description: Insert a layer into the image's layer stack.
pitfalls: position -1 appends to the top of the stack.

procedures.name: gimp-layer-copy
procedures.description: Duplicate a layer, optionally adding an alpha channel.
pitfalls: The copy must still be inserted into the image.

procedures.name: gimp-layer-merge-down
procedures.description: Merge the active layer down into the one below.

procedures.name: gimp-layer-set-offsets
procedures.description: Move a layer by setting its offset relative to the image top-left.
pitfalls: The procedure name is plural: gimp_layer_set_offsets (there is no singular gimp_layer_set_offset).

procedures.name: gimp-layer-set-opacity
procedures.description: Set a layer's opacity percentage.

procedures.name: gimp-layer-set-mode
procedures.description: Set a layer's blend mode (SCREEN_MODE, MULTIPLY_MODE, etc.).
pitfalls: Mode constants live in gimpfu (NORMAL_MODE, SCREEN_MODE, MULTIPLY_MODE, OVERLAY_MODE, ...).

procedures.name: gimp-item-set-visible
procedures.description: Show or hide a layer/item.

procedures.name: gimp-item-set-name
procedures.description: Rename a layer/item.

procedures.name: gimp-image-get-active-layer
procedures.description: Get the currently active layer.

procedures.name: gimp-image-get-layers
procedures.description: List all top-level layers in the image.

procedures.name: gimp-image-select-color
procedures.description: Select all pixels in the drawable whose color matches.
pitfalls: Color is RGBA tuple. Larger threshold selects a wider range.

procedures.name: gimp-selection-invert
procedures.description: Invert the current selection.

procedures.name: gimp-selection-all
procedures.description: Select the entire canvas.

procedures.name: gimp-selection-none
procedures.description: Clear the current selection.

procedures.name: gimp-selection-grow
procedures.description: Grow the selection by a number of pixels.

procedures.name: gimp-selection-feather
procedures.description: Feather the selection edges by a radius.

procedures.name: gimp-image-select-ellipse
procedures.description: Select an elliptical region on the image. The standard way to create circular/oval selections for vignettes, round crops, etc.
procedures.signature: pdb.gimp_image_select_ellipse(image, operation, x, y, width, height)
pitfalls: CRITICAL: there is NO pdb.gimp_selection_ellipse in Python-Fu - that name only exists in Script-Fu. The correct Python-Fu call is pdb.gimp_image_select_ellipse(image, operation, x, y, width, height).
operation is a CHANNEL_OP_* constant: CHANNEL_OP_REPLACE, CHANNEL_OP_ADD, CHANNEL_OP_SUBTRACT, CHANNEL_OP_INTERSECT.
There is also no pdb.gimp_ellipse_select(canvas_w, canvas_h, w, h, cx, cy, antialias, from_center) and no FROM_CENTER constant. Pass explicit top-left x, y and CHANNEL_OP_REPLACE.

procedures.name: gimp-image-new
procedures.description: Create a brand new empty RGB image. Required to generate scenes from scratch.
pitfalls: A new image has no layers: insert at least one layer with pdb.gimp_layer_new + pdb.gimp_image_insert_layer, and make it visible on screen with pdb.gimp_display_new(image).
type is RGB (0) or RGBA (1); constants RGB_IMAGE and RGBA_IMAGE also work.

procedures.name: gimp-edit-blend
procedures.description: Fill a drawable with a gradient between the context foreground and background colors.
procedures.signature: pdb.gimp_edit_blend(drawable, blend_mode, paint_mode, gradient_type, opacity, offset, repeat, reverse, supersample, max_depth, src_x, src_y, dst_x, dst_y, blend_space, gradient_transform)
procedures.example: pdb.gimp_edit_blend(sky, BLEND_FG_BG_RGB, 0, GRADIENT_LINEAR, 100, 0, REPEAT_NONE, True, False, 3, 0, 0, 1200, 800, 0, 0)
pitfalls: CRITICAL: requires all 16 arguments: drawable + 15 params including src_x, src_y, dst_x, dst_y gradient endpoints and the trailing blend_space (0) and gradient_transform (0) - any missing raise TypeError.
A bridge runtime alias also tolerates shorter model-style forms (missing paint_mode/offset/endpoints, which default to 0 and the drawable diagonal).
blend_mode uses BLEND_FG_BG_RGB (0), BLEND_FG_BG_HSV (1), BLEND_FG_TRANSPARENT (2) or BLEND_CUSTOM (3). There is NO FG_BG_LINEAR_BLEND or FG_BG_RGB_BLEND constant in GIMP 2.10.
paint_mode must be an int, typically 0 (PAINT_MODE_NORMAL does not exist in 2.10).
gradient_type GRADIENT_LINEAR (0) or GRADIENT_SOLID (1); repeat REPEAT_NONE (0) or REPEAT_SAWTOOTH (1).

procedures.name: gimp-pencil
procedures.description: Draw a polyline on a drawable with the context foreground color.
pitfalls: points_array is a single FLAT list of x,y pairs: [x0, y0, x1, y1, ...]. It is NOT separate x and y lists.
Use pdb.gimp_context_set_foreground((r, g, b)) first to set the line color.

procedures.name: gimp-drawable-fill
procedures.description: Fill a drawable with the current background, foreground, white or transparency.
pitfalls: fill_type is FOREGROUND_FILL (0), BACKGROUND_FILL (1), WHITE_FILL (2) or TRANSPARENT_FILL (3).
pdb.gimp_edit_fill(drawable, fill_type) also exists and fills the active selection; gimp_drawable_fill ignores the selection.

procedures.name: gimp-context-set-background
procedures.description: Set the context background color, used by gradients and background fills.
pitfalls: Pass an (r, g, b) tuple with values 0-255. Set foreground with pdb.gimp_context_set_foreground((r, g, b)).

procedures.name: gimp-ellipse-select
procedures.description: Model-shorthand for gimp_image_select_ellipse. Supported at runtime by an alias in the bridge plugin.
procedures.signature: pdb.gimp_ellipse_select(image, operation, x, y, width, height)
pitfalls: Prefer the canonical pdb.gimp_image_select_ellipse(image, operation, x, y, width, height) form.
Do NOT use a GIMP-3 style gimp_ellipse_select(canvas_w, canvas_h, w, h, cx, cy, antialias, from_center) call and do not pass FROM_CENTER.

procedures.name: gimp-image-select-rectangle
procedures.description: Select a rectangular region on the image.
procedures.signature: pdb.gimp_image_select_rectangle(image, operation, x, y, width, height)
pitfalls: CRITICAL: there is NO pdb.gimp_selection_rectangle in Python-Fu - use pdb.gimp_image_select_rectangle(image, operation, x, y, width, height).

procedures.name: gimp-image-select-round-rectangle
procedures.description: Select a rectangle with rounded corners on the image.
procedures.signature: pdb.gimp_image_select_round_rectangle(image, operation, x, y, width, height, corner_radius_x, corner_radius_y)

procedures.name: gimp-selection-shrink
procedures.description: Shrink the current selection inward by a number of pixels.
pitfalls: Only works when there is an active selection.

procedures.name: gimp-selection-border
procedures.description: Convert the current selection to a border of the given width.

procedures.name: gimp-selection-translate
procedures.description: Move the current selection by an offset.

procedures.name: gimp-selection-combine
procedures.description: Combine the current selection with the saved channel in the given channel-op mode.

procedures.name: gimp-brightness-contrast
procedures.description: Adjust brightness and contrast of a drawable.
pitfalls: Only affects the selected region.

procedures.name: gimp-desaturate-full
procedures.description: Convert a drawable to grayscale using a desaturation method.
pitfalls: 0=luminosity, 1=average, 2=lightness.

procedures.name: gimp-levels
procedures.description: Adjust levels (input/output range, gamma) for a channel.
procedures.signature: pdb.gimp_levels(drawable, channel, low_input, high_input, gamma, low_output, high_output)
pitfalls: HISTOGRAM_VALUE = value channel; use HISTOGRAM_RED/GREEN/BLUE for per-channel.

procedures.name: gimp-hue-saturation
procedures.description: Adjust hue, saturation and lightness over a hue range.
pitfalls: Saturation scale is -100..100.

procedures.name: gimp-colorize
procedures.description: Colorize a drawable with a hue/saturation/lightness tint.
pitfalls: A common way to tint images (sepia, cyan, etc.).

procedures.name: plug-in-gauss
procedures.description: Apply a Gaussian blur.
pitfalls: Only affects the selected region.

procedures.name: plug-in-unsharp-mask
procedures.description: Sharpen using unsharp mask.

procedures.name: plug-in-noise
procedures.description: Add uniform random noise to a drawable.

procedures.name: gimp-item-transform-flip-simple
procedures.description: Flip an item horizontally or vertically.

procedures.name: gimp-item-transform-rotate-simple
procedures.description: Rotate an item by an angle in degrees.

procedures.name: gimp-edit-fill
procedures.description: Fill the selection (or drawable) with the foreground/background color.
pitfalls: Set the color first with gimp_context_set_foreground.

procedures.name: gimp-context-set-foreground
procedures.description: Set the foreground color used by tools and fills.

procedures.name: gimp-displays-flush
procedures.description: Refresh all open displays so edits are visible.
pitfalls: ALWAYS call after pixel edits or the UI won't update.

procedures.name: gimp-display-new
procedures.description: Open a new display window for an image so it becomes visible in the GIMP UI.
pitfalls: MANDATORY when you create a brand-new image with gimp-image-new: without gimp_display_new(image) the image exists only in memory and GIMP shows a blank window. Call it right after building the canvas, then pdb.gimp_displays_flush().
Also save the new image to disk with pdb.gimp_file_save(image, drawable, path, path) using an absolute path, or the work is lost when GIMP closes.

procedures.name: gimp-image-select-polygon
procedures.description: Select a closed polygon region on the image, given as a flat list of x, y coordinates. The correct way to draw trapezoids, triangles, or any other angled shape - not gimp_edit_blend, which is for gradients and cannot create arbitrary polygon shapes at all.

params.name: segs
params.example: [x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, x4, y4]  # flat list of float/int coordinates (do NOT pass num_segs in Python-Fu)

pitfalls: In GIMP Python-Fu (gimpfu), pdb.gimp_image_select_polygon takes exactly 3 arguments: (image, operation, segs). Do NOT pass num_segs / len(points) as a 4th argument - pygimp calculates array length automatically and passing a 4th argument raises TypeError: wrong number of parameters.
`segs` must be a FLAT list [x1, y1, x2, y2, ...], not a list of (x, y) tuples - passing tuples will fail.

Do not use gimp_edit_blend to approximate an angled shape like a trapezoid - it is a gradient-fill call, not a shape tool, and its constants (blend mode, paint mode, repeat mode) are extremely easy to get wrong. Use this procedure instead, then fill the resulting selection the normal way with gimp_context_set_foreground + gimp_edit_fill.

procedures.name: gimp-message
procedures.description: Display a message in the GIMP error console (status bar). Use for debugging or user feedback.
pitfalls: Messages appear in the error console, not as a popup dialog.
